description: Additional fictional event-related messages for reviewing the live rolling digest. Every participant and arrangement is synthetic.

messages.text: Taylor, can we review the mobile calendar and event editor on Monday, September 7, 2026, 10:00–10:45 Riyadh time? I have booked Studio 1.
Confirmed for Monday, September 7, 2026, 10:00–10:45 Riyadh time. I will bring the latest interactive prototype.
Small location update: the design critique is in Studio 2, not Studio 1. The date and 10:00 start stay unchanged.
The calendar usability session is planned for Tuesday, September 8, 2026, 14:00–15:00 Riyadh time. We will test finding an event and importing an ICS file.
That usability slot works for me. Please include the reminder settings in the session.
The usability session needs to move to Tuesday, September 8, 2026, 15:30–16:30 Riyadh time. The previous 14:00 slot is cancelled.
Confirmed: usability testing is Tuesday, September 8, 2026, 15:30–16:30 Riyadh time. This replaces the earlier slot.
The usability session is remote. Use https://meet.example.com/calendar-usability as the fictional test meeting link.
The partner handoff is Wednesday, September 9, 2026, 09:00–09:30 New York time (UTC−04:00). Taylor and Mina, please join remotely.
Confirmed. The partner handoff is 16:00–16:30 Riyadh time on Wednesday, September 9, 2026; that is the same meeting, not a second booking.
Please reserve Thursday, September 10, 2026, 11:00–12:00 Riyadh time for release planning. We will review the rollout checklist.
Release planning is confirmed for that hour. I will attend.
The accessibility review is booked for Thursday, September 10, 2026, 11:30–12:00 Riyadh time. Can you attend, Taylor?
I have accepted the accessibility review, but it overlaps my release planning meeting. Keep both arrangements visible for now; neither has been moved yet.
Can we do the security walkthrough on Friday, September 11, 2026, 16:00–16:30 Riyadh time? It is a review session, not a statement that approval is complete.
Yes, the security walkthrough slot works.
The security walkthrough is cancelled. We are waiting for the reviewer to return. No replacement date has been agreed; please do not keep the old slot as an upcoming meeting.
The revised copy needs to be ready by Friday, September 18, 2026. We have agreed the date only, not a time of day.
I will prepare the revised copy. Please leave the time unspecified until we agree one.
Maybe we could have an office-hours chat next week about the retention-policy questions. I have not proposed a day or a time.
That would be useful, but it is still tentative. Let us agree a slot before putting it on the calendar.
I will send the partner handoff brief by Tuesday, September 8, 2026, 18:00 Riyadh time, ahead of the handoff call.
I will upload the accessibility checklist by Wednesday, September 9, 2026, 17:00 Riyadh time.
The interactive calendar prototype for the design critique is ready. I will walk through it at the confirmed session.

reviewPoints: Design critique: one event, 10:00–10:45, location updated to Studio 2.
Usability session: only the replacement 15:30–16:30 slot should be proposed.
Partner handoff: 09:00 New York and 16:00 Riyadh describe the same event.
Release planning and accessibility review overlap; neither should be silently moved.
Cancelled security walkthrough must not remain an active upcoming suggestion.
Copy deadline has a known owner and date, but no invented time.
Office hours remain tentative without an invented date or time.
Preparation commitments stay linked to the relevant contact and conversation.
